title: Demodesk vs. Fireflies: Transcription Accuracy for Sales Calls
summary: Fireflies transcribes meetings well. Demodesk is built for the accuracy sales teams need in high-stakes calls across every channel. Here’s the honest comparison.
body_markdown:
**Short answer:** Fireflies is a solid general-purpose meeting notetaker with transcription accuracy in the 85–95% range for clear audio. Demodesk is a sales-specialized AI meeting assistant built for the conditions where that range breaks down: multi-accent calls, phone and dialer audio, procurement names, product jargon, and the moment a transcript becomes a CRM record a VP will read. If your calls are English-only Zoom demos, Fireflies will do the job. If your calls are high-stakes, multi-channel, and feed coaching, CRM updates, and deal reviews, that extra 5–15 percentage points of accuracy is where deals are won or lost.


This is an honest comparison from the Demodesk team. We’ll stay in the parts of the field where we can be specific.


## Why transcription accuracy matters more in sales than in general meetings


Transcription accuracy is usually quoted as a single number. In sales, that number hides everything that matters.


A[2025 arXiv study of state-of-the-art ASR models](https://deepgram.com/learn/conversational-intelligence-for-enterprise-sales) found that even at 2.7% overall Word Error Rate, those same models made errors on **28.9% of person names and 19.6% of organization names** . The sales-call translation: the transcript gets the filler right and the champion’s name wrong. The CFO becomes “CFL.” The competitor you lost to becomes a plausible-sounding other word. The product your prospect asked about gets normalized to something generic.


Industry benchmarks reinforce this.[Call transcription accuracy benchmarks](https://www.cleverly.co/blog/call-transcription-accuracy-benchmarks) put most tools at **85–95% accuracy under good audio conditions** and lower when conditions degrade.[Granola’s own analysis](https://www.granola.ai/blog/ai-sales-meeting-recorders-captured-missed) notes that a 95% accuracy claim means roughly 75 word errors in a typical 10-minute call, and real-world conditions can drop accuracy by 5–15 percentage points.


In a general team meeting, 75 errors in 10 minutes is tolerable. In a procurement call where the DPO says “we need the DPA appendix updated before the works council review,” those are the exact words you need right.


## Fireflies: what it does well, where it falls short for sales


Fireflies is a general-purpose meeting notetaker. It joins video calls, transcribes, generates summaries, and syncs to CRM on paid tiers. It supports a wide range of languages and has a strong free tier that drives individual adoption.


Where Fireflies does well:


- Clean video calls with native English speakers
- Individual productivity use cases
- Teams that want a lightweight notetaker across all meetings, not just sales


Where it falls short for high-stakes sales:


- **Video-first capture.** Fireflies joins meetings as a bot. Phone, dialer, in-person, and field conversations fall outside the capture net unless you stitch together uploads manually.
- **General-purpose vocabulary.** Fireflies’ models are not fine-tuned on sales conversations. Product names, methodology terminology (MEDDIC, BANT), procurement language, and buyer titles are more likely to drift.
- **Accuracy claims are generic.** Fireflies markets ~90% accuracy under good conditions, consistent with the industry baseline. For high-stakes calls with accented English, phone-quality audio, or multi-party dynamics, that baseline degrades the way every ASR system does.
- **Insights, not actions.** Fireflies transcribes and summarizes. The CRM update, the coaching score, the deal risk flag — those are either absent or sit behind separate workflows.


Fireflies is a notetaker. For many teams, that’s enough. For sales teams where the transcript is the source of truth for coaching, forecasting, and compliance, that’s where deals slip.


## Demodesk: built for sales accuracy, on every channel


Demodesk is an AI meeting assistant built for sales teams. The transcription engine is fine-tuned on over 10 million real sales conversations and covers 98 languages. That matters for two reasons:


1. **Sales vocabulary is modeled.** Methodology terms, product names, deal stages, procurement language — the models have seen them.
2. **Custom vocabulary is built in.** You can pass up to 120 characters of brand names and technical terms (e.g., “LapID”, your product names) to the transcription engine directly. That closes the gap on the one thing generic transcribers reliably get wrong: the proper nouns in your deals.

## From transcript to action: why accuracy matters downstream


Most comparison posts stop at transcription. They miss the point.


Transcription accuracy is not the goal. The goal is what the transcript enables.


In Demodesk, every conversation becomes the record four AI agents act on:


- **AI Assistant** generates the summary and drafts the follow-up email. If “DPA appendix” transcribes as “the pay appendix,” the follow-up email sounds like you weren’t paying attention.
- **AI Coach** scores every call against your scorecard — MEDDIC, BANT, or your own. A scorecard that penalizes a rep for “not confirming the economic buyer” when they did confirm it, but the name was mis-transcribed, erodes trust in coaching fast.
- **AI CRM Concierge** fills Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive fields with 99% accuracy, with a human-in-the-loop preview before anything syncs. Field accuracy depends on transcript accuracy. If the competitor name is wrong, your competitive intel is wrong.
- **AI Deal Insights** flags deal risks from what was said. “Our DPO wants a 30-day review” is a different flag than “our DPL wants a 30-day review.”


Fireflies gives you the transcript and the summary. Demodesk uses the transcript to do the work — coaching, CRM, follow-ups, deal risk — and holds itself to the accuracy standard that work demands.


## The honest take: when Fireflies is the right choice


Fireflies is a reasonable choice if any of these are true:


- Your team is small (under ~10 people) and the notetaker is for individual productivity, not team visibility
- Your calls are almost entirely video-based with native English speakers
- You don’t need coaching, CRM automation, or deal risk flagging
- You want a free or near-free tier for personal use


If your calls span multiple channels, multiple languages, or multiple stakeholders where the transcript feeds a CRM record, a coaching score, or a deal review, the accuracy ceiling of a general notetaker becomes a business cost. That’s where Demodesk is built to win.


## What EU sales teams need to know


If you’re selling into or from Europe, there’s a layer underneath accuracy that most US-built tools skip.


Fireflies is US-hosted. Demodesk is German-founded, hosted in Azure Frankfurt (EU-only), ISO 27001:2022 certified, and GDPR-native with works council-compatible consent flows. Retention is configurable: 12 hours up to 1 year, with bookmarked recordings excluded from auto-deletion. Your sales manager keeps the coaching library. The works council agreement gets satisfied.


Your data never trains our AI. No transatlantic data transfers. For DACH buyers whose first question is “where is our customer data stored,” that’s a different conversation than retrofitting a US tool into GDPR compliance.
